Nonce account instruction handlers and transaction age checks for the system program.

# Purpose
This C file implements the `fd_system_program` logic for nonce account handling in the transaction executor. It contains the instruction execution paths for `AdvanceNonceAccount`, `WithdrawNonceAccount`, `InitializeNonceAccount`, `AuthorizeNonceAccount`, and `UpgradeNonceAccount`, plus helper functions for account checks, sysvar access, durable nonce creation, and nonce state encoding and decoding. The code follows the Solana system program rules for nonce accounts and uses the transaction context, bank blockhash queue, rent sysvar, and recent blockhashes sysvar to validate each instruction before it updates account state.

The file also defines [`fd_check_transaction_age`](<#fd_check_transaction_age>), which validates transaction age against the recent blockhash queue or a durable nonce account. It checks whether the transaction blockhash is still recent, or whether the transaction uses a valid nonce account with the correct system program instruction, writable nonce account, and matching authority signature. When the nonce path is valid, it prepares the nonce account for update and stores rollback data in the transaction context.
